remarks: Welcome home to this charming and very well-maintained two-bedroom, one full bath, co-op townhouse offers warmth, comfort, and everyday ease in one of Stamford's owner-occupied, pet-friendly communities. Hardwood floors throughout, a bright and inviting living area, an eat in kitchen perfect for gatherings. The finished lower level provides flexible space for a home gym, office or playroom complete with in-unit washer and dryer for added convenience. Enjoy parking just steps from your door, and in a prime location that's minutes to Cove Island Beach, Cummings Park, Chelsea Piers, downtown Stamford, and the train station. Easy access to I-95 makes commuting a breeze. This home is move-in ready. Great opportunity to own in Sylvan Knoll!
